actions.name: Jump
actions.joystick: trigger or button1 after device test

actions.name: Swing
actions.note: Attach to the highest-scored reachable WebAnchor2D on performed; release on canceled.

actions.name: Aim
actions.note: Optional bias only. Zero input uses velocity direction, then facing/up bias.

actions.name: WebZip
actions.note: Post-MVP action: pull toward an anchor without entering a full pendulum swing.

actions.name: ToggleCalibration
actions.gamepad: start+select handled as a chord in code
actions.joystick: button8+button9 handled as a chord in code

eight_bit_controller_check: Open Window > Analysis > Input Debugger and confirm whether the controller appears as Gamepad or Joystick.
Exercise every button and both sticks before finalizing bindings.
Prefer XInput mode on Windows when the controller supports it.
Save interactive rebinding overrides to PlayerPrefs; do not hard-code a specific 8BitDo model.
